items.title: What has Bharat always been known for?
items.explanation: Bharat is known worldwide as a land of wise and heroic individuals. Its rich and diverse culture has attracted numerous travelers since ancient times.

items.title: What is attractive about Bharat?
items.explanation: Bharat is attractive because it is a land rich with rivers, lakes, and high mountains, featuring green forests that are home to many plants, insects, birds, and animals. These elements ensure that Bharat prospers and is respected globally.

items.title: What is special about the fact that the people live here in unison?
items.explanation: The passage highlights that the people of Bharat live together in unity, presenting to the world a message of unity in diversity.
